edis.title: edis
edis.description: Dissociation energies data file now lives in the kimmdy root config as `config.edissoc`

itp.title: itp
itp.description: Additional itp file with bonded parameters is no longer required and directly read from the forcefield.

dt_distances.title: dt_distances
dt_distances.description: Use `stride` instead. The value is ignored.

stride.title: stride
stride.description: Use every stride-th frame of the trajectory for calculating bond distances. The time between frames is set by nstxout-compressed (xtc) or nstxout (trr). 1 means use every frame.

trajectory.title: trajectory
trajectory.description: Trajectory used for calculating bond distances. `xtc` files are written more often but with lower precision (`compressed-x-precision`) and may only contain the `compressed-x-grps` group (System or Protein), `trr` files contain all atoms at full precision.

bond_selection.title: bond_selection
bond_selection.description: MDAnalysis selection string for atoms whose bonds are monitored for homolysis. Only bonds of the topology with both atoms in the selection are used, e.g. `backbone or resname LY2 LY3 L4Y L5Y LYX` to include crosslinks.

bond_exclude.title: bond_exclude
bond_exclude.description: Space-separated atom names or bonds excluded from the monitored bonds. An atom name (e.g. `O`) excludes bonds with that atom, a trailing `*` (e.g. `H*`) excludes atom names starting with the prefix and two atom names joined by a hyphen (e.g. `C-N`) exclude bonds between those atoms.

check_bound.description: Check the topology for bonds between monitored atom pairs and only attempt to break them if they are actually bonded. Monitored bonds are taken from the current topology, so this only matters for bondstats read from a cache file (`recompute_bondstats: false`) that may contain bonds broken since.

use_morse.description: Calculate transition rates using a morse potential (the default). If set to `false`, a harmonic potential is used instead.

eyring_equation.title: eyring_equation
eyring_equation.description: Parameters of the Eyring equation k = kappa * kB * T / h * exp(-dV / (R * T)) converting the force-lowered barrier dV into a rate.

transmission_coefficient.description: Dimensionless transmission coefficient kappa. The default reproduces the earlier Arrhenius frequency factor of 0.288 1/ps at 300 K.

arrhenius_equation.title: arrhenius_equation
arrhenius_equation.description: Use eyring_equation instead. Both values must be given. The frequency factor A is converted to transmission_coefficient = A * h / (kB * T) and overrides eyring_equation. The earlier default behavior is reproduced with frequency_factor 0.288 and temperature 300, which is equivalent to the eyring_equation defaults.

frequency_factor.description: Frequency factor in 1/ps. Use 0.288 for the earlier default.

temperature.description: Temperature in K. Use 300 for the earlier default.

b0_overwrite.title: b0_overwrite
b0_overwrite.description: Offset in nm added to the force field b0 of all monitored bonds; positive values lower the bond forces. With an offset, forces are calculated at the mean bond distance instead of averaged over the trajectory frames (the same for harmonic bonds, an approximation for Morse bonds). Mainly useful for testing. 0 disables the offset.

f0_overwrite.title: f0_overwrite
f0_overwrite.description: Force in kJ/mol/nm subtracted from the mean force of all monitored bonds before calculating rates; negative results are set to 0. Mainly useful for testing.

recompute_bondstats.title: recompute_bondstats
recompute_bondstats.description: Recompute bondstats (mean distance and force) even if a .kimmdy.bondstats cache file is found.
